test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The current population of a city is 125000. If the population grows at the rate of 2% per year, what will be the population of the city after 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Current population of the city = 125000

Growth rate = 2% per year

Number of years = 3

**Formula:**

Population after n years = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

where:

P = Current population

r = Growth rate

n = Number of years

**Solution:**

Population after 3 years = 125000(1 + 2/100)³ = 125000(1.02)³ = 132651

**Therefore, the population of the city after 3 years will be 132651.**
